title: Toward Sustainable AI Deployment: A Carbon-Aware Decision Framework for Enterprise Supply Chain Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.14881v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprises deploying AI for supply chain decisions commonly default to the largest available language model, a procurement heuristic that neglects both empirical performance and environmental cost. We benchmark six large language models across 520 supply chain tasks, simultaneously measuring decision quality and estimated generation-related operational carbon. Drawing on the Technology-Organization-Environment (TOE) framework, we develop a Carbon-Aware AI Procurement Framework (CAAPF), a Green IS design artifact that operationalizes sustainable AI governance for enterprise procurement. Within this bounded sample, quality spans 0.497-0.723, and the models with the largest disclosed parameter totals do not achieve the highest scores. The design does not isolate size, provider, architecture, or benchmark-construction effects. translated_title: 迈向可持续的AI部署：面向企业供应链系统的碳感知决策框架
translated_abstract: 企业在部署AI进行供应链决策时，通常默认选择可用的最大语言模型，这种采购策略既忽视了实证性能，也忽视了环境成本。我们在520个供应链任务上对六个大型语言模型进行了基准测试，同时测量决策质量和估算的生成相关运营碳排放。基于技术-组织-环境（TOE）框架，我们开发了碳感知AI采购框架（CAAPF），这是一个绿色信息系统设计工件，将可持续AI治理落实到企业采购实践中。在该有限样本内，决策质量介于0.497至0.723之间，且披露参数总量最大的模型并未取得最高分数。该设计未能分离模型规模、提供商、架构或基准构建方式的影响。一个按类别和层级进行校准的GreenRoute概念验证达到了0.733的平均样本外质量，估算的碳排放（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究基于520个供应链任务的基准测试发现参数量最大的语言模型并非决策质量最优，并提出碳感知AI采购框架（CAAPF），为企业提供兼顾决策质量与碳排放的可持续AI采购决策方案。
en_tdlr: This study benchmarks six LLMs across 520 supply chain tasks, showing that the largest models do not achieve the highest decision quality, and proposes a Carbon-Aware AI Procurement Framework (CAAPF) enabling enterprises to balance decision quality with carbon emissions in sustainable AI procurement.
